extracted.name: White Sangria
extracted.description: This white sangria is the perfect summer cocktail for a crowd! A mix of white wine, orange liqueur, and summer fruit, it's fruity, refreshing, and so easy to make. Note that this recipe tastes best after it chills overnight, so make sure to prep it a day before serving.
ingredient_lines: 1 small orange (thinly sliced into rounds or half-moons)
¼ cup fresh mint leaves (plus more for garnish)
1 (750 mL) bottle light-bodied, dry white wine (I like Pinot Grigio or Sauvignon Blanc)
¼ to ½ cup orange liqueur (like Cointreau or Grand Marnier)
¼ cup simple syrup (or peach schnapps)
instruction_lines: In a large pitcher, place the peaches, orange, lime, berries, and mint.
Pour in the wine, ¼ cup orange liqueur, water, and simple syrup or peach schnapps and stir. Taste, adding more orange liqueur for a boozier sangria. Chill overnight.
Pour into glasses filled with ice. Garnish with fresh mint and serve.
